regime_context: The detector shows a broad, non-directional rotation in Canada: Base Metals & Copper leads narrowly over Oil & Gas Producers (margin 0.11), with 9 of 16 themes eligible under the absolute-trend gate and half of clean sectors in rank-1 territory. Leadership is concentration without conviction — breadth is middling (0.56), durability bars are sub-0.65 everywhere, and the backtest verdict frames momentum rank as a focus lens only, with the single validated edge being drawdown control via the trend gate.
emerging_watch: Watching for a CONFIRMED handoff from Base Metals & Copper to Oil & Gas Producers: retire this watch if XEG.TO ranks #1 and XBM.TO drops below rank 2 for five consecutive trading days, or if the margin between them exceeds 0.5 with both still eligible.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: The trend gate leg (eligible=true) is the only validated edge, and Base Metals & Copper is the eligible leader with the highest score. Not a return forecast — a drawdown-tilting conditional: staying with the eligible leader is defensible until trend-health fails, and its durability_bar (0.5), non-crowded flag (crowding_z 0.9), and 0.56 breadth keep it a coherent holding rather than a crowded top.
evidence: rank 1, score 1.655, eligible=true under absolute-trend gate
scorable proxy XBM.TO available for grading
theses.dissent: hurst_tag='mean-revert' and the backtest's rank-IC ~0 mean the momentum lead carries no forward return edge; the leadership is coincident attention and could roll over without warning.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO closes below its 50-day moving average and stays there for two consecutive weeks before the check-by date

theses.subject: Technology
theses.thesis: Technology is the only eligible theme flagged crowded (crowding_z 1.16, crowded=true) while mid-table (rank 8, score -0.21). Crowding is a SIZE-DOWN caution only, never a short — the avoid lean reflects that the trend-gate discipline adds nothing to be long a crowded, negative-score theme, not that it will fall.
evidence: scorable proxy XIT.TO available for grading
theses.dissent: crowding in a small TSX tech complex can persist and even be reflexive on the upside; avoiding a crowded leader can miss continuation.

falsifier.text: XIT.TO rises by 10% relative to the S&P/TSX benchmark before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: As the eligible challenger just 0.11 behind the leader, Oil & Gas has the highest durability_bar on the board (0.61) and the broadest breadth (0.571) among leaders — trend-health legs are the only pieces with backtested value, and this theme scores best on both while staying non-crowded.
evidence: scorable proxy XEG.TO available for grading
theses.dissent: hurst_tag='mixed' and the near-tie with the leader means any single commodity headline could break the rotation in either direction; the lead is not confirmed by margin.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO relative to XBM.TO drops by more than 5% over any 10-trading-day window before the check-by date
